About us:

Branch is on a mission to empower workers with financial freedom. We do this by helping companies accelerate payments and providing working Americans with accessible, free financial services. We’re committed to building and delivering more inclusive, transparent, and frictionless financial products.

Our goal of empowerment extends to our own employees, too. Have a great idea? Share it today and it might just get implemented tomorrow. As a member of our team, your voice and creativity matter—and they can directly impact our products, company, and culture. 

We not only focus on attracting great talent from across the country, but also on building teams that help that talent thrive. That means valuing a diversity of opinions and working styles, while creating a shared belief in innovation, initiative, and winning together.

Come join our team as we develop new ways to improve the lives of working Americans.

About the role:

The Compliance Analyst is a hands-on member of the Branch Compliance team, supporting the day-to-day operation of our Compliance Management System (CMS). Branch delivers its products through sponsor bank partnerships, so this role sits at the intersection of Branch's compliance program and our bank partners' expectations. You will review alerts and cases, handle customer complaints, and help test and document how our controls work. You will work closely with the entire Compliance team and gain exposure to AML/BSA, OFAC, EFTA/Reg E, ACH, UDAAP, and TCPA across products such as earned wage access, deposit accounts, and payments.

What You'll Do:

Financial crimes and onboarding

  • Review and disposition alerts from transaction monitoring, primarily cash/credit loads, documenting the rationale for each decision
  • Investigate unusual or potentially suspicious activity and escalate potential UAR referrals, maintaining strict confidentiality
  • Recommend and help test changes to alert rules and thresholds as risk trends evolve, in coordination with Compliance Managers

Complaints and consumer compliance

  • Monitor and triage customer complaints for regulatory concerns, including UDAAP and EFTA/Reg E
  • Gather the supporting records (customer communications, transaction history, call recordings) and draft responses using standardized templates, meeting required deadlines
  • Analyze complaint data for trends and root causes, and report findings

Program support

  • Assist with annual policy and procedure reviews and maintain compliance records and trackers
  • Support compliance reviews of new products, features, and customer communications
  • Use AI-assisted tools and workflow automation to improve the speed and quality of alert review, complaint handling, and reporting

What We're Looking For:

Required

  • 2-4 years of compliance experience in financial services; fintech, bank, or sponsor-bank program experience preferred
  • Working knowledge of laws and regulations applicable to financial services, such as BSA/AML, OFAC, and EFTA/Reg E; familiarity with UDAAP, NACHA rules, or Reg CC/DD is a plus
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with clear writing for case narratives and complaint responses
  • Comfort working with data and spreadsheets to analyze alerts and trends; SQL is a plus
  • Sound judgment and discretion with confidential and sensitive information
  • Proactive self-starter who works independently and as part of a team, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and exceptional organizational skills
  • Compliance certification such as CAMS or CRCM is a plus

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $90-97k. The salary range displayed reflects an average base salary range for the position across all the U.S. The base salary offered to an applicant could be higher or lower based on each applicant's specific skill set, depth of experience, relevant education or training, etc. 

Location:

This position is classified as REMOTE within the United States of America.

We are unable to hire candidates located outside of the domestic U.S.

Benefits: 

  • Market-leading medical, dental, and vision insurance 
  • Stock options
  • Free Premium-Tier Origin Financial Wellness subscription
  • Monthly home-office stipend
  • 401k (TransAmerica)
  • 12-weeks paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents
  • Flexible time off + sick and safe time
  • 11 paid company holidays
  • Branch@Branch Same Day Pay Option

Identity Verification

As part of our application process, you'll receive a separate email from Greenhouse shortly containing a unique identity verification link. This step, powered by Persona, helps us confirm applicant identities and keep our hiring process secure for everyone. 

Upon identity verification, all biometric data is deleted. If you need support completing this application, please reach out to Careers@branchapp.com

Working at Branch

A remote-first company with employees located throughout the U.S., Branch emphasizes transparency, accountability, and trust to create a collaborative environment where our product, engineering, marketing, customer support, customer success, and sales teams can all thrive together.  Learn more about what we do in this video!

Our collaborative spirit has helped us become an award-winning FinTech company, with Branch’s innovation and workplace recognized across industries. Branch has been honored by Inc., the Webby Awards, Benzinga FinTech Awards, FinTech Breakthrough Awards, Top Workplaces USA, Great Places to Work, and EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Heartland, among others.  

Learn more about our culture, approach, technology, and people here: https://www.branchapp.com/about

 

Branch is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Must be currently authorized to work in the USA without sponsorship or transfer.

No third-parties, please.
